name: ways-of-working
description: Thirteen ways-of-working skills that compute from files you already have: a CAB-style change record from a Terraform plan or PR export, one action ledger across meeting notes, a security exception register lint, a quarterly risk register refresh against findings exports, an RFC writer with a lifecycle lint, a one-file-per-decision log, a weekly status note from git and gh exports, a private 1:1 ledger, meeting load and focus blocks from a calendar export, a weighted vendor scorecard with a sensitivity check, a check of a team's working agreement against GitHub settings exports, a shift handover note from incident and alert exports, and one ranked do-next list from saved mail and chat exports across work and personal accounts. Standard-library scripts, no network, no rating of people.
